name: EPIC-SOUNDS: A Large-Scale Dataset of Actions That Sound
description: EPIC-SOUNDS is a large-scale audio dataset of actions that sound, independently annotated on the audio streams of 100 hours of unscripted egocentric video from EPIC-KITCHENS-100. It comprises approximately 117.6K annotated audio event segments (117,553 segments total), distinguishing 78,366 categorized segments across 44 audio classes from 39,187 non-categorized audible segments described with free-form vocabulary. The dataset provides standardized partitions for audio recognition (including 60,055 training segments, 8,035 validation segments, and 5,131 recognition test timestamps) and sound event detection.
